name: 48375 · Novi, MI
findings: ZIP 48375 (Novi) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48375 (Novi) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48375 (Novi) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
